_meta.purpose: Rootpass country stock data. Every group was read from the source URL given. Groups that could not be confirmed are empty and marked verified:false.
caveats: Merchant ranges change. Treat these as 'commonly listed by at least one named merchant/mill', not a guarantee of stock at every branch.
Where a merchant table was garbled in extraction, walls were re-derived from the listed kg/m against the same sizes' standard masses; this is noted per group.

AU.chs_note: InfraBuild Black CHS to AS/NZS 1163, walls listed as Extra Light / Light / Medium / Heavy / Extra Heavy.

plate.note: 3 and 4 mm plate not confirmed on this page (only floor plate / one Edcon 1200x2400 8 mm listing seen). Sheet under 5 mm added 23 Nov from InfraBuild Steel Centre sheet tables (hot-rolled (HA1S formable, HA3 pickled, Brightform), cold-rolled, galvanised (Galvabond)): https://www.infrabuild.com/steel/products/sheet-and-coil/hot-rolled-steel-sheet-and-coil/

lengths.tube_note: InfraBuild: SHS/RHS lengths 6.5 m, 8.0 m and 12.0 m (larger sizes 8.0/12.0). CHS/pipe standard length 6.5 m.
lengths.angle_note: Edcon Steel: 6.0 m for smaller merchant-bar angles; 9.0 or 12.0 m for larger structural angles.

pipe.series: AS 1074 (Steel tubes and tubulars for ordinary service), Light / Medium / Heavy; nominal size by DN. C250 pipe also certified to AS/NZS 1163.
pipe.note: Medium/Heavy from InfraBuild 'Medium & Heavy Pipe to Australian Standards' (AS 1074, C250); Light from its 'Light / Extra Light Pipe' table (C350, AS 1163). DN15 not in this document. InfraBuild's own Black CHS page lists DN80 Heavy as 5.0 vs 4.9 here. Same doc: AS 1074 pipe used under AS 4041 limited to 1210 kPa up to DN100 and 1030 kPa above DN100. Standard length 6.5 m.

standards.welding: AS/NZS 1554.1 (Structural steel welding - Welding of steel structures), current edition 2014
standards.hollow: AS/NZS 1163:2016 (Cold-formed structural steel hollow sections), grades C250L0/C350L0/C450L0
standards.src_note: store.standards.org.au pages are JavaScript-rendered; title/status confirmed through search-result listings of those pages, and AS 4041 pressure note in the InfraBuild PDF.

terms.trade: boilermaker (Boilermaker-Welder is an ANZSCO specialisation in unit group 3223; trade qualification MEM31922 Cert III Engineering - Fabrication Trade (Boilermaking/Welding))
terms.note: 'mitre' and 'aluminium' as AU spellings not separately sourced from an AU page (Vulcan NZ uses 'Mitre'); standard AU/NZ English.

AU.notes: Not verified: 20x20 SHS (not on InfraBuild page), flat bar stock length, 3-4 mm plate, DN15 pipe. Merchants: InfraBuild Steel Centre, Edcon Steel, BlueScope Distribution (BlueScope SHS page has no size table).

NZ.hollow_note: Vulcan NZ 2024 stock catalogue (sources: NZ Steel, Australian Tube Mills). Its table lists kg/m under wall columns; walls here were matched from those kg/m values against the same sizes' standard masses because the PDF text columns are misaligned.
NZ.chs_note: No separate NZ CHS (structural) list read; use pipe sizes below (Vulcan lists pipe by NB with XL/L/M/H walls).
NZ.angle_note: Vulcan prints '75 x 65' for the row whose masses (5.27/6.81/8.73/10.5 kg/m) are 75x75 equal angle; recorded as 75x75. Walls matched from kg/m.
NZ.flat_note: Vulcan 300PLUS flats; thickness matched from listed kg/m (w x t x 0.00785).

lengths.tube_note: Steel & Tube: SHS up to 90x90 in 6.5 m / 8.0 m; 100x100 and up in 8.0 m / 12 m; RHS 8.0 m / 12 m.
lengths.note: Steel & Tube catalogue is dated 2013; Vulcan 2024 catalogue states no lengths.

pipe.series: NB sizes, Extra Light / Light / Medium / Heavy (AS 1074 gas-list pipe per Steel & Tube; Vulcan lists the same walls).
pipe.note: Steel & Tube 2013 also lists API/Sch 40/80 line pipe but its PDF table extracts garbled, so Sch values are not recorded for NZ.

standards.hollow: AS/NZS 1163 (Steel & Tube lists SHS/RHS to AS/NZS 1163 C350L0 or C350L0/C450L0)
standards.piping: AS 4041 via AS/NZS 1200 (WorkSafe NZ Approved Code of Practice for Pressure Equipment (Excluding Boilers), 2001 edition, points pressure equipment to AS/NZS 1200)
standards.piping_note: NZ piping route seen only via search summaries (ACOP + Wikipedia); the ACOP PDF itself was not opened.

terms.trade: boilermaker / welder (ANZSCO is shared with Australia)

NZ.notes: Vulcan catalogue (2024) is the stock list used; Steel & Tube 2013 catalogue used only for lengths/standards. Easysteel not verified. NZ CHS (structural) and Sch 40/80 values not recorded.

GB.shs_note: BM Steel, BS EN 10219, S235JRH/S355J2H. Page 1 of 2 read (50 of 57 products), so a few larger walls may be missing.
GB.angle_note: BM Steel equal angles, BS EN 10025-2 S275JR, 6000 mm.
GB.flat_note: BM Steel black flats S275JR; page 1 of 2 read (50 of 93), so wider/thicker sizes are incomplete. Note UK flats use 15 mm (not 16).

lengths.tube_note: BM Steel hollow sections sold in 7.5 m (product spec '(L)7500mm'); a few RHS at 12 m. Its FAQ text separately says 'typically 6 metres' - conflicting; product listings used.

pipe.series: BS EN 10255 (replaced BS 1387) Medium and Heavy series, thread sizes 1/8 to 6; specified OD 10.2-165.1 mm. Pressure/process pipe commonly to EN 10216/10217 or ASME B36.10M schedules (not verified here).
pipe.note: Walls from Engineering ToolBox EN 10255 table; specified ODs from ArcelorMittal e-steel EN 10255 listing (21.3x2.6 'M'), EN 10255 scope (10.2-165.1 mm) and the standard's own order example '26,9 x 2,6'. A UK supplier PDF (valvestubesfittings) prints older BS 1387 values (2.65/3.25 etc.) - do not mix.

standards.welding: BS EN 1090-2 (execution of steel structures, current BS EN 1090-2:2018+A1:2024) with weld quality to BS EN ISO 5817; welding quality system BS EN ISO 3834 (ISO 3834 not separately verified)
standards.hollow: BS EN 10219 (cold-formed, e.g. S235JRH/S355J2H) and BS EN 10210 (hot-finished)
standards.note: EN 13480 and ISO 3834 are listed from the brief; no page for them was read.

terms.pipe_size: DN or inch thread size; 'medium/heavy tube'
terms.note: BM Steel navigation uses 'Aluminium Treadplate'. Trade title not source-verified.

GB.notes: Barrett Steel / Metals4U / Parkers not read (BM Steel used). BM SHS/RHS/flat lists are page 1 of 2.

IE.shs_note: Ferrum (Dublin), EN 10219:2006 S235/S355. 120 and 150 x 8/10 are 12.2 m only.
IE.angle_note: Ferrum equal angle, BS EN 10025-2 S275JR.
IE.flat_note: Ferrum flat bar S275JR, 3-25 mm. Only the 40 and 50 mm rows (all thicknesses ticked) could be read unambiguously; other rows' tick-to-column mapping was malformed in the page.

lengths.flat_note: Ferrum table heading 6.1/6.4 m; its text also says 'standard 6m lengths'.

pipe.series: EN 10255 Medium / Heavy (same as GB). Ferrum stocks galvanised tube 1, 1 1/4, 2, 2 1/2 in at 6.25 m but does not state walls.

standards.welding: I.S. EN 1090-2 with EN ISO 5817 (EN 1090 is a European standard; Irish adoption name not verified)
standards.note: Only the hollow section and EN 10025-2 references were read on an Irish page; welding/piping names assumed equal to the European standards and not verified for Ireland.

terms.hollow: 'box section' (Ferrum page title 'Box Section') / SHS / RHS / CHS
terms.note: Spellings not separately sourced on an Irish page.

IE.notes: Single Irish merchant (Ferrum, Dublin) used; Barrett Steel Ireland exists but no size list was read. Irish lengths differ from UK (7.6/12.2 m hollow, 6.25 m angle/round).

US.shs_note: Metals Depot 'square steel tube': A513 for light gauge, A500 Gr B for structural. Fractional walls given as decimal of the fraction (3/16=0.188).
US.chs_note: Metals Depot round-tube URL tried returned 404; use pipe (NPS) below. Not verified.
US.angle_note: A36 hot rolled equal angle, labels e.g. 2x2x1/8.
US.flat_note: A36 hot rolled flat bar; Metals Depot lists thickness first (e.g. 1/4 x 2). 1/16 in sizes come only in 8 ft and are omitted.

plate.grade: A36 plate (thinner is sheet, by gauge)

lengths.tube_note: Square/rect tube max stock length 24 ft (some sizes 20 ft); also 2-12 ft cuts.

pipe.series: NPS with ASME B36.10M schedules; Metals Depot pipe is A53 (and A500 structural pipe). Inches.
pipe.note: Only schedules Metals Depot lists. NPS 5 Sch 80 and 3-1/2 Sch 80 not listed there.

standards.welding: AWS D1.1/D1.1M Structural Welding Code - Steel (latest D1.1/D1.1M:2025-AMD1)
standards.hollow: ASTM A500 (structural tube, Gr B per Metals Depot); ASTM A513 for light-gauge mechanical tube
standards.piping: ASME B31.1 (power piping), ASME B31.3 (process piping)

terms.length_unit: foot/feet and inches (meter if metric shown)
terms.note: Metals Depot uses 'Aluminum' and 'Square Steel Tube'; 'miter' spelling not seen on a page read.

US.notes: Atlas Tube, Ryerson, Online Metals not read (Online Metals returned 403). US CHS/round mechanical tube not verified.

CA.units: imperial: Canadian service centres list HSS, pipe, flat bar and plate in inches and feet (Russel Metals, Sureway Metal). CSA G40.20/G40.21 is a metric-capable standard and Atlas Tube publishes CSA metric section properties, but merchant listings read were all imperial.
CA.shs_note: Russel Metals (Atlantic) HSS product page: a size/weight table, not explicitly a stock list; grades/lengths not stated there. Weights spot-checked as consistent for SHS.
CA.rhs_note: Metals R Us (metalsrus.ca) CSA 44W rectangle tube list, read 23 Nov 2026.
CA.angle_note: Range only (Sureway): equal 3/4x3/4x1/8 up to 8x8x3/4; unequal 2x1-1/2x3/16 up to 8x6x1/2. Individual sizes not listed.
CA.flat_note: Range only (Sureway): 1/8 x 3/4 to 1 x 12 in, 20 ft lengths.

plate.note: Range only (Sureway): 16 ga (1/16 in) to 6 in; sheets 4x8 ft to 10x40 ft.

pipe.series: NPS with ASME B36.10M schedules (Sureway: Sch 40 1/4-8 in, Sch 80 1/2-6 in, 20 and 21 ft).
pipe.note: OD/wall values are the ASME B36.10M figures recorded under US (Metals Depot); Sureway confirms the schedules stocked, not the dimensions.

standards.welding: CSA W59 Welded steel construction (current W59:24); fabricator certification to CSA W47.1 (not verified here)
standards.hollow: CSA G40.20/G40.21 (e.g. 350W; store lists G40.20-13/G40.21-13 R2023); ASTM A500 also stocked
standards.piping: CSA B51 Boiler, pressure vessel, and pressure piping code (B51-2024), which references ASME B31.1/B31.3
standards.src_note: Editions confirmed through search-result listings of CSA/ANSI store pages; pages not opened in full. W47.1 not checked.

terms.length_unit: ft/in on merchant lists; metre (Canadian spelling) in metric/CSA contexts - not source-verified
